verdict.rationale: 2FAS Pass is a password manager, so breach alerts and weak, reused or exposed credential warnings are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents none of these: no breach monitoring and no password-health audit. Security Tiers, encryption and the password generator are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed
